field.name: my_compassion_description
field.eval: 'Would you like to be a voice for underprivileged children within your ' 'church and help raise awareness among Christians about poverty and ' 'injustice in the Global South? We are looking for one church advocate per ' 'church in Switzerland. As an advocate, you will coordinate Compassion’s ' 'presence within the church—home groups, youth ministries, and Sunday ' 'school—working in collaboration with church leaders. We provide a wide ' 'range of resources to support you, including presentations, videos, ' 'Sunday school materials, and event announcements. This is a valuable ' 'opportunity to respond to Jesus’ call to care for the most vulnerable and ' 'the least of these.'

field.name: my_compassion_description
field.eval: 'We are looking for volunteers to stand up for children who have no ' 'voice of their own. Become a voice that can make a real difference for ' 'underprivileged children around the world. Concerts, conferences, and ' 'church presentations offer excellent opportunities to share your own ' 'experience as a sponsor and inspire others with your passion for ' 'releasing children from extreme poverty.'

field.name: my_compassion_description
field.eval: 'Is sport an important part of your life? Turn your passion into action ' 'by taking part in a muskathlon—whether a marathon, ultra walk, road ' 'cycling, or mountain biking—or another sporting event organized by ' 'Compassion.'

field.name: my_compassion_description
field.eval: 'Our prayers can make a powerful difference in the lives of children and ' 'families living in extreme poverty. Receive regular prayer points to ' 'guide your intercession for underprivileged children, Compassion’s ' 'partner churches across the Global South, and the challenges Compassion ' 'faces in Switzerland.'

field.name: my_compassion_description
field.eval: 'Help build a meaningful connection between sponsors and children. ' 'Around 30% of the letters exchanged between sponsored children and ' 'sponsors require translation. If you are confident in a foreign language ' '(German, English, Spanish, or Portuguese), this meaningful role allows ' 'you to read children’s letters and discover a core element of our work: ' 'the life-changing relationship of encouragement between a sponsor and a ' 'child.'

field.name: my_compassion_description
field.eval: 'TOGETHER is Compassion’s fundraising platform. Anyone can start their ' 'own fundraising campaign—individually or as part of a group project—to ' 'support development projects implemented by Compassion in the Global ' 'South. In just a few clicks, you can launch your own campaign, set a ' 'fundraising goal, and choose an end date. You can then invite family and ' 'friends via email, Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and other channels to ' 'support your fundraising goal through financial contributions.'
